answer: The forge ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own zephyr record, and its own share of the lantern quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 645 identities would post 3239 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
